cloves and curl of a fresh lemon peel.

celebrated Essence of Bishop; requires the wine only to be
added.

wine, in a cup, they will make a sweet bishop when gentle
folks sup.—After Snift,

    We beg" respectfully to call your attention to the
annexed fac-simile of a Label we have adopted as the
distinguishing mark of the identity of our PALE Ale.

of Pale Ale has rather assisted than prevented deception.
Wc trust the one we have now adopted—the figure of which
belongs to us as our Trade Mark—will be a means of
securing us and the public against the fraud that has been
so long and so generally complained of.
